newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace says to go ahead with share allocation.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace says to go ahead with share allocation.

text.p: Nippon Lace Co Ltd said on Monday that it would go ahead with a plan for a third-party allocation of new shares in early April after cancelling the plan last week.
It will issue six million new shares at 280 yen per share to two investors to whom it originally planned to allocate the new shares, Nippon Lace said in a statement.
The payment date will be April 7, the lace maker said.
The company said in February that it would issue six million new shares at 590 yen per share in a third-party allocation. Nippon Lace said at the time that the payment date would be March 12.
But on March 11, it cancelled its original plan due to a fall in share prices.
Nippon Lace's shares stood at 306 yen on March 11 and closed at 245 yen on Monday.
